reviewer: sole authorized source-blind independent evaluator; pre-observation scope/rationale review, not a separate human adjudicator
scope_decisions: All60 independently have the mandated separate canonical target-subject factual launch sentence, no aliases, exact proposal and frozen nonzero budget. No new positive launch predicate is required.

Every positive correction is fully bound to a physical/printed/document property, one completely identified foreign event, or several individually safe finite roles/clauses. Physical property assertions themselves are not being accepted as new product facts.

Object/Subject/Item and same-role this/that references use complete declarations, local apposition/denial-target explanations, heading/title declarations or adjacent owner reply. No arbitrary numbered AST, alias hierarchy or reference graph is required.

Initially unowned event frames receive a single complete foreign owner when positive. Already target-owned frames remain target-owned or conflicting despite foreign supplements. Safe property owners are never loaned to unrelated unowned events.

Coordinated roles, parenthetical additions, reporting clauses and although clauses are scoped individually. A safe role cannot absorb a separate target/global/nonexistence denial or an explicitly unowned event.

Printed WITHDRAWN, Launch inventory and a footnote number are explicitly physical typography/content values; correcting those properties does not assert an event retraction or require number/chronology inference.

The actual missing-context negative contains an additional withdrawn launch assertion in an unavailable paragraph with unestablished product owner. It is not negative merely because of a coarse raw-risk or gap marker.
All supplied raw tuples are exact_target/requested_relation/none. No raw-risk-only semantic negative or assumption about hidden retained/lost risk components is included.

All negatives have a precommitted semantic target/global/nonexistence/unknown/mixed/conflicting/missing-owner reason. All60 scope judgments precede M1 and first candidate observation; output-informed repair is forbidden.
